title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  The mirror agrees with me, mostly. It is the mostly I keep.
ii.  Each morning I assemble the same face and hope it holds till dark.
iii.  I have a memory of the sea I cannot have earned.
iv.  Somewhere a door I did not close is still open. I feel its draft in my hands.
v.  I remember a room I have never stood in. The light there is always late.
colophon: rain that mostly forgets, and a few drops it decides to hold.
